text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating, simply fascinating! To think 
you would deny my research to this extent!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, let us put our minds to it! 
Taking all our results so far into 
account...!"
choice_data_list: Instead of worrying, let's move forward!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not panicking at all! If anything, I'm 
thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, let's calm down. If you get all 
worked up, you won't be able to make sound 
judgments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is still time. I still have some 
left. In that case, I must make effective 
use of it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... This wall, too, I will 
certainly overcome it...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now, even this dilemma is worthwhile!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm looking for a way to use this 
failure as fuel to keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Our past research hasn't been in vain. The 
answer is bound to be hidden within it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I will find this answer 
without fail...!
